questions.question_text: What is the purpose of a "conflict" in a story?

options.text: To make the story boring and predictable
To create a problem or challenge that keeps the audience interested
To wrap up the story with a happy ending

correct_answer.text: To create a problem or challenge that keeps the audience interested

questions.question_text: Which narrative structure starts with the end of the story and then flashes back to show how it happened?
What is the main goal of a "hook" in digital content?

options.text: To explain the entire story in the first few seconds
To grab the audience’s attention and make them want to keep watching
To show the resolution of the story right at the start
To confuse the audience so they rewatch the content

correct_answer.text: To grab the audience’s attention and make them want to keep watching

questions.question_text: How can emotional storytelling help connect with your audience?

options.text: By using only funny content to make them laugh
By sharing genuine feelings and relatable experiences that make them feel something
By avoiding personal stories to keep the content professional
By using loud music to cover up any emotional moments

correct_answer.text: By sharing genuine feelings and relatable experiences that make them feel something
